sources.title: A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
sources.snippet: The concept of knowledge distillation in the field of AI and deep learning (DL) refers to the process of transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student) Gou et al. (2021).

sources.title: A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
sources.snippet: TL;DR: This survey introduces a roofline model framework for systematic analysis of Large Language Model (LLM) inference techniques, identifying bottlenecks and providing a deeper understanding of practical aspects on real devices, covering weight optimization, decoding algorithm improvements, and hardware/system-level enhancements.

sources.title: Knowledge Distillation - GeeksforGeeks
sources.snippet: Knowledge Distillation is a model compression technique in which a smaller, simpler model (student) is trained to imitate the behavior of a larger, complex model (teacher). Instead of learning directly from data, the student model learns from the soft targets or probabilities, which are produced by the teacher model.
